newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lernout licenses technology to U.K. firm.
newsitem.headline: Lernout licenses technology to U.K. firm.

text.p: Belgium's Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products NV said on Tuesday its text-to-speech technology had been licensed to provide read-back capability to British-based Aptech for its Keystone for Windows application.
The application helps people who have problems in document production, for example those with dyslexia or visual and psychical impairments, it said in a statement.
The Lernout and Hauspie technology would allow users of Keystone for Windows to verify what they had typed into their computers, the company said.
Keystone for Windows is sold in England, and other European language versions are foreseen, it said. The application is priced at $525 for a single user licence.
